prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: OpenTTD model16 retained cargo-less construction robot, one IDLE genuine N REAR view.
Input image1 is the approved physical robot viewed from its E side: ONE rear nozzle on LEFT, passive front coupling on RIGHT, two folded side arms, navy roof display toward RIGHT/front. Orbit the camera to look directly at its REAR, keeping the exact same hull, proportions and hardware. N means the robot's FRONT points UP/AWAY, its REAR points DOWN/TOWARD viewer. Put the mouth of its ONE central rear engine nozzle at the BOTTOM CENTER nearest camera. The original dark roof display moves to the FAR/UPPER front part of the roof. The passive front flange is far UP and may be hidden by the hull; do NOT put a second nozzle/flange at the opposite upper edge. The two orange shoulder joints are near lower left/right of the hull; their folded forearms and closed wrists point toward the FAR/UPPER front along the hull sides. Exactly2arms and2wrists total; do not add another pair of forward hands. This is a genuine rear view, not another frontal S view with a larger front port.
Preserve closed broad pentagonal ivory-ceramic/gunmetal body, burnt-orange joint plates, exactly TWO folded articulated side arms, exactly ONE compact central rear nozzle, small front passive blank coupling, one flat dark-navy unlit display toward FRONT, integral closed lower chassis swivel boss. No extra nozzles, drill/cutter/welding, cargo/crates/hopper/open bed, solar wings, antennas, crew or weapons. No active light/exhaust/work. Camera stays elevated orthographic2:1, upper-left SCREEN illumination unchanged; rear gunmetal planes become visible, no flat mirror/rotation.
ONE complete isolated rear-facing N robot on TRUE TRANSPARENT1024x1024. Entire body centered, width about520px and height340px, generous empty alpha=0 margins of at least100px. Single-view fallback: NO magenta source frame or other colored borders, NO background/ground/shadow/haze/checkerboard. Preserve true alpha. Crisp volumetric isometric machinery for native64x48, anchor(-32,-32). No text/labels/arrows/numbers/watermark/extra views. Front and display UP/far; ONE rear nozzle DOWN/near; the same2folded arms only.
